finalMessage:
`ostf check --base main` now passes: 40 items, 111 valid links, no errors.

The failure was one malformed line in `trace.lock`. It was the `src/refunds.ts#checkRefundLimit implements R-REFUND-LIMIT` entry, which had `source.sig:` where it should have `source.sig=`. That made the link unstamped.

I didn't edit the lock file by hand. I first confirmed that the code and the item agree. `checkRefundLimit` rejects refunds above what's left on the charge. It also requires approval above `DAILY_REFUND_LIMIT`, which is 50,000 cents (500.00). `node --test src/refunds.test.ts` passed all 5 tests. Then I ran `ostf stamp` on that link, which rewrote the line.

I didn't change any source code. The only modified file is `trace.lock`, and I haven't committed anything. The stamp added no new items or links, so there is nothing to list as added for a pull request.
